_about: Event idea cards for SHUFFLE. category is service, leadership, or fellowship. For service cards, area must match a name in serviceAreas (the 8 Leo service areas). Give a new card the next id. Keep concept and twist to one short sentence each.
healthNote: Diabetes, Vision, and Childhood Cancer ideas are awareness activities. Any screening, diagnosis, or medical advice needs qualified professionals and partner organisations.

cards.name: Brighter Days
cards.concept: Create personalised hope and activity kits for children.
cards.twist: Each kit is personalised around the child's interests.

cards.name: Little Artists
cards.concept: Create a collaborative art activity where children and volunteers build one large artwork together.
cards.twist: Display the final artwork as a shared celebration piece.

cards.name: Storytime Heroes
cards.concept: Organise an interactive storytelling session built around courage, imagination and friendship.
cards.twist: Children create their own ending to the story.

cards.name: Superhero Saturday
cards.concept: Children create superhero identities, powers and stories through art and games.
cards.twist: Every child receives a personalised superhero badge.

cards.name: The Joy Cart
cards.concept: Create a portable cart filled with books, crafts, games and creative activities.
cards.twist: The cart rotates through different activity themes.

cards.name: Sugar Smart
cards.concept: Turn diabetes awareness into a quiz-based interactive experience.
cards.twist: Teams earn points for answering myth-vs-fact questions.

cards.name: Label Detective
cards.concept: Teach participants how to understand food labels.
cards.twist: Participants become food detectives and solve label-based challenges.

cards.name: Move 30
cards.concept: Organise a 30-minute community movement challenge.
cards.twist: Turn the activity into a team challenge.

cards.name: Smart Plate
cards.concept: Create an interactive activity around building balanced meals.
cards.twist: Participants build their plates under different fictional scenarios.

cards.name: Healthy Habit Bingo
cards.concept: Participants complete simple healthy-habit challenges.
cards.twist: Use a physical bingo board and team rewards.

cards.name: Ready in 10
cards.concept: Teach participants how to think through a basic emergency plan.
cards.twist: Give teams only 10 minutes to build their emergency plan.

cards.name: Emergency Go-Bag
cards.concept: Demonstrate what belongs in an emergency preparedness kit.
cards.twist: Teams compete to correctly build a sample go-bag.

cards.name: Disaster Bingo
cards.concept: Teach disaster preparedness through a game.
cards.twist: Each square contains a preparedness action or scenario.

cards.name: Map Your Safety
cards.concept: Participants create simple emergency contact and safety maps.
cards.twist: Turn mapping into a timed team activity.

cards.name: Preparedness Challenge
cards.concept: Teams solve realistic disaster-preparedness scenarios.
cards.twist: Each team receives a different scenario card.

cards.name: Pocket Forest
cards.concept: Transform a small unused space into a green corner.
cards.twist: Give the space a name and create a community story around it.

cards.name: Waste to Wonder
cards.concept: Turn discarded materials into useful or artistic objects.
cards.twist: Run it as a timed maker challenge.

cards.name: Plastic Detective
cards.concept: Help participants understand their everyday plastic use.
cards.twist: Participants complete a one-day plastic audit challenge.

cards.name: Clean-Up Quest
cards.concept: Turn a community clean-up into a team-based mission.
cards.twist: Teams earn points for completing different cleanup missions.

cards.name: Eco Escape Room
cards.concept: Build an environmental puzzle experience.
cards.twist: Teams must solve environmental clues to complete the mission.

cards.name: Seed Stories
cards.concept: Plant seeds alongside personal wishes or messages.
cards.twist: Each plant carries a story or message.

cards.name: Repair Café
cards.concept: Teach participants to repair everyday objects rather than discard them.
cards.twist: Participants learn one repair skill from another participant.

cards.name: Green Birthday
cards.concept: Demonstrate how to celebrate a birthday with less waste.
cards.twist: Design the entire celebration around reusable materials.

cards.name: Kindness Café
cards.concept: Create a café-style experience where kindness becomes the currency.
cards.twist: Participants earn tokens through acts of kindness.

cards.name: One Hour For Someone
cards.concept: Volunteers donate one hour of time to help, teach or accompany someone.
cards.twist: Track the total number of hours donated.

cards.name: Letters That Matter
cards.concept: Write handwritten appreciation letters for people whose work often goes unnoticed.
cards.twist: Deliver letters anonymously as surprise appreciation.

cards.name: 100 Acts of Kindness
cards.concept: Complete 100 small acts of kindness collectively.
cards.twist: Create a public impact tracker.

cards.name: Human Library
cards.concept: People become “books” and share personal experiences through short conversations.
cards.twist: Participants choose which “book” they want to hear from.

cards.name: Community Canvas
cards.concept: Create one large collaborative artwork with community members.
cards.twist: Every participant contributes one section.

cards.name: Meal With Meaning
cards.concept: Turn food support into a community dining experience focused on dignity and connection.
cards.twist: Add a storytelling or conversation component.

cards.name: Community Kitchen Day
cards.concept: Volunteers prepare and serve meals together.
cards.twist: Divide volunteers into rotating kitchen teams.

cards.name: One Meal Challenge
cards.concept: Members collectively fund a target number of meals.
cards.twist: Use a visible progress tracker.

cards.name: Smart Food, Less Waste
cards.concept: Run an interactive workshop about food waste.
cards.twist: Teams compete to design the lowest-waste meal plan.

cards.name: Community Cookbook
cards.concept: Collect affordable recipes and stories from the community.
cards.twist: Create a digital or printed community cookbook.

cards.name: Nutrition Through Games
cards.concept: Teach children basic food and nutrition concepts through games.
cards.twist: Turn learning into a points-based game.

cards.name: Vision Quest
cards.concept: Create interactive awareness stations around eye health.
cards.twist: Use a passport/stamp system for each station.

cards.name: Screen Smart
cards.concept: Create awareness around healthy screen habits.
cards.twist: Turn it into a challenge-based activity.

cards.name: Eye Myth Busters
cards.concept: Run a myth-vs-fact awareness game.
cards.twist: Teams compete to identify myths.

cards.name: Read Without Limits
cards.concept: Create accessible reading resources.
cards.twist: Co-create accessible reading materials with participants.

cards.name: See Through Their Eyes
cards.concept: Create an accessibility and empathy-focused experience.
cards.twist: Use structured perspective-taking activities.

cards.name: Skill Swap Saturday
cards.concept: Young participants teach one another practical skills.
cards.twist: Everyone must teach one skill and learn one skill.

cards.name: Future Founders
cards.concept: Children create imaginary businesses and learn about ideas, customers and pricing.
cards.twist: End with a mini marketplace or pitch round.

cards.name: Career Compass
cards.concept: Create mini career stations hosted by professionals.
cards.twist: Participants collect stamps from different career stations.

cards.name: Dream Board
cards.concept: Youth create visual boards representing their future goals.
cards.twist: Add a letter-to-future-self component.

cards.name: Mini Makers Lab
cards.concept: Build useful objects from recyclable materials.
cards.twist: Give every team the same materials but a different challenge.

cards.name: Street to Stage
cards.concept: Create a youth talent showcase.
cards.twist: Let the audience vote on creative categories.

cards.name: Money Matters
cards.concept: Teach financial literacy through games and scenarios.
cards.twist: Participants manage a fictional monthly budget.

cards.name: Future Fair
cards.concept: Create interactive career and skill exploration stations.
cards.twist: Add unexpected careers and emerging fields.

cards.name: One Day, One Skill
cards.concept: Professionals teach one practical skill in a short session.
cards.twist: Participants leave with a mini challenge to practise the skill.

cards.name: Youth Idea Lab
cards.concept: Teams solve a community problem and pitch their solution.
cards.twist: Give each team a random constraint they must design around.

cards.name: Leader for a Day
cards.concept: Members take turns running a real club meeting, from agenda to minutes.
cards.twist: The newest member chairs the meeting.

cards.name: Pitch Night
cards.concept: Each member pitches one project idea in 3 minutes. The club votes one idea into the calendar.
cards.twist: A panel of past presidents asks the questions.

cards.name: Mock Board Room
cards.concept: The board solves a made-up club crisis together, like a sponsor pulling out a week before an event.
cards.twist: A new twist card lands every 10 minutes.

cards.name: Speak Up Circle
cards.concept: Public speaking practice with short, surprise topics.
cards.twist: Every speaker picks their topic from a jar and gets 2 minutes.

cards.name: Mentor Match
cards.concept: Pair new members with experienced Leos for one month.
cards.twist: Each pair completes three small missions together.

cards.name: Leadership Escape Room
cards.concept: Teams solve puzzles that need clear roles, delegation, and calm under pressure.
cards.twist: The team leader may not touch any clue.

cards.name: Plan in 60
cards.concept: Teams plan a complete event in 60 minutes using the A4 Toolkit.
cards.twist: Each team draws a random budget and audience.

cards.name: Alumni Talks
cards.concept: Past Leos share how their Leo years shaped their careers and choices.
cards.twist: The audience asks questions on cards, picked at random.

cards.name: Brand Sprint
cards.concept: Refresh the club's Instagram look and bio in one afternoon.
cards.twist: Show a before-and-after to the whole club at the end.

cards.name: Budget Masterclass
cards.concept: The treasurer teaches event budgeting using real past budgets.
cards.twist: Teams must balance a mystery budget with one surprise cost.

cards.name: Minutes That Matter
cards.concept: A workshop on writing minutes, reports, and event documentation.
cards.twist: Teams write minutes of a live, role-played meeting.

cards.name: Conflict Café
cards.concept: Role-play common team conflicts and practise calm, fair solutions.
cards.twist: Everyone swaps roles halfway through.

cards.name: Shadow Board
cards.concept: Junior members shadow an office bearer for one month.
cards.twist: The shadows run one official meeting on their own.

cards.name: Sponsor Pitch Lab
cards.concept: Practise sponsor calls and emails in front of a mock CSR panel.
cards.twist: The panel gives instant scores and one tip each.

cards.name: Roadmap Day
cards.concept: The club agrees on its goals for the year and builds one shared visual roadmap.
cards.twist: Revisit the roadmap at the mid-year meeting.

cards.name: Leo Olympics
cards.concept: An inter-club sports day with relay races, tug of war, and fun games.
cards.twist: Every team must include members from at least two clubs.

cards.name: Potluck and Stories
cards.concept: Every member brings a home dish and the story behind it.
cards.twist: Everyone guesses who cooked what before the stories start.

cards.name: Sunrise Trek
cards.concept: An early-morning trek to a nearby fort or hill.
cards.twist: Breakfast at the top and a group photo challenge.

cards.name: Game Night
cards.concept: An evening of board games, card games, and party games.
cards.twist: Teams reshuffle after every round.

cards.name: Movie Under the Stars
cards.concept: An open-air movie screening with snacks and blankets.
cards.twist: Members vote on the movie a week before.

cards.name: Mystery Basket Cook-Off
cards.concept: A cooking contest where every team gets the same surprise ingredients.
cards.twist: Club alumni are the judges.

cards.name: Karaoke Night
cards.concept: A relaxed karaoke evening for members and friends.
cards.twist: Every duet must pair people from different clubs.

cards.name: Photo Walk
cards.concept: Explore a neighbourhood together with phones or cameras.
cards.twist: Each team gets a list of photo themes to find.

cards.name: Secret Leo
cards.concept: A week where every member secretly does small kind things for one other member.
cards.twist: The big reveal happens at the next meeting.

cards.name: Beach Day
cards.concept: A day of beach games, food, and time together.
cards.twist: Start with a 30-minute beach clean-up before the fun.

cards.name: Throwback Party
cards.concept: A 90s-themed evening with music, dress code, and retro games.
cards.twist: Best-dressed awards chosen by the guests.

cards.name: Quiz Night
cards.concept: A team quiz on pop culture, general knowledge, and Leo trivia.
cards.twist: One round is only about the club's own members.

cards.name: Friendship Cup
cards.concept: A cricket or football tournament between clubs.
cards.twist: Teams are mixed, with players from different clubs.

cards.name: Bonfire Night
cards.concept: An evening around a bonfire with music and snacks.
cards.twist: End with a gratitude round: everyone thanks one person.

cards.name: Welcome Mixer
cards.concept: A welcome evening for new members with icebreaker games.
cards.twist: Every new member is paired with a buddy for their first month.
